When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm not here for pleasantries. Who entered that zero, and did anyone call me first?

I'd rather not coach you on how to handle her while the meeting is paused, because that would take away the challenge you set up to practise, but the debrief after END MEETING gives you specific feedback on what moved her and what cost you ground.
